english.title: Leave m/vehicle on a road not attended by person licensed to drive it engine not stopped / parking brake not set
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), left on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was not attended by a person licensed to drive it, when the

(A)_[engine had not been stopped]_
(B)_[parking brake had not been effectively set]_
(C)_[engine had not been stopped and the parking brake effectively set]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 107(1) of the Road Vehicles(Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the RoadTraffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

on a road

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Offence is not committed if there is a person, licensed to drive, somewhere in the vehicle.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) Additional information may be included in the Statement of facts to provide detail of any movement of the vehicle and damage caused thereby.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H261 and H262.
(v) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied

(B)_[hand brake not effectively set.]_
(C)_[engine running and the hand brake not effectively set.]_

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
